metadata.startup-script:
#!/bin/bash
exec > /var/log/vllm-startup.log 2>&1
set -ex # Enable command tracing and exit on error

echo "Starting Queued vLLM Bootloader..."
echo "-----------------------------------"
echo "Project ID: aisprint-491218"
echo "Zone: us-west4-a"
echo "Model Name: xbill9/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-w8a8-int8-emb4"
echo "HF_SECRET_ID: hf-token"
echo "-----------------------------------"

# Ensure internet connectivity
echo "Checking internet connectivity..."
set +e # Allow ping to fail without exiting immediately
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  echo "Attempt $i/30: Pinging 8.8.8.8..."
  ping -c 1 8.8.8.8
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Internet connected."
    break
  fi
  echo "Ping failed, retrying in 5 seconds..."
  sleep 5
  if [ $i -eq 30 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Internet connectivity failed after multiple retries. Exiting."
    exit 1
  fi
done
set -e # Re-enable exit on error

# Docker pull the pinned vLLM image the patches are written against
echo "Pulling vLLM Docker image: vllm/vllm-tpu@sha256:19a1a0526476f902eb83e1057f3d8938f35b457dd7716a30e9ab4f7bee90d507"
set +e # Allow docker pull to fail without exiting immediately
for i in $(seq 1 5); do
  echo "Attempt $i/5: sudo docker pull vllm/vllm-tpu@sha256:19a1a0526476f902eb83e1057f3d8938f35b457dd7716a30e9ab4f7bee90d507"
  sudo docker pull vllm/vllm-tpu@sha256:19a1a0526476f902eb83e1057f3d8938f35b457dd7716a30e9ab4f7bee90d507
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Docker image pulled successfully."
    break
  fi
  echo "Docker pull failed, retrying in 20 seconds..."
  sleep 20
  if [ $i -eq 5 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Failed to pull vLLM Docker image after multiple retries. Exiting."
    exit 1
  fi
done
set -e # Re-enable exit on error

# Patch tpu_inference inside the image and commit it as vllm-tpu-w8a8emb4:patched: upstream's JAX path
# has no int8 W8A8 linears, int4 embedding tables or quantized lm_head, and Gemma4ForCausalLM
# needs a text-only config fallback.
# The patches (patches/ in the rig, applied in ORDER) are embedded below as a base64 tar.gz.
echo "Building vllm-tpu-w8a8emb4:patched from vllm/vllm-tpu@sha256:19a1a0526476f902eb83e1057f3d8938f35b457dd7716a30e9ab4f7bee90d507 with the rig's patches..."
command -v patch >/dev/null || sudo apt-get install -y -qq patch
PATCH_DIR=/opt/vllm-patches
sudo rm -rf $PATCH_DIR /opt/tpu_inference_src && sudo mkdir -p $PATCH_DIR /opt/tpu_inference_src
echo "" | base64 -d | sudo tar xz -C $PATCH_DIR
SITE=$(sudo docker run --rm --entrypoint python3 vllm/vllm-tpu@sha256:19a1a0526476f902eb83e1057f3d8938f35b457dd7716a30e9ab4f7bee90d507 -c "import os,tpu_inference;print(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(tpu_inference.__file__)))" | tail -1)
sudo docker rm -f vllm-patch > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
sudo docker create --name vllm-patch vllm/vllm-tpu@sha256:19a1a0526476f902eb83e1057f3d8938f35b457dd7716a30e9ab4f7bee90d507 > /dev/null
sudo docker cp "vllm-patch:$SITE/tpu_inference" /opt/tpu_inference_src/
for p in $(cat $PATCH_DIR/ORDER); do
  echo "Applying $p (sha256 $(sha256sum $PATCH_DIR/$p | cut -c1-16))"
  (cd /opt/tpu_inference_src && sudo patch -p1 --forward < $PATCH_DIR/$p) || { echo "ERROR: patch $p did not apply"; exit 1; }
done
sudo docker cp /opt/tpu_inference_src/tpu_inference/. "vllm-patch:$SITE/tpu_inference/"
sudo docker commit vllm-patch vllm-tpu-w8a8emb4:patched > /dev/null
sudo docker rm vllm-patch > /dev/null
echo "Patched image vllm-tpu-w8a8emb4:patched ready."

# Set vLLM environment variables
echo "Setting vLLM environment variables..."
VLLM_MODEL="xbill9/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-w8a8-int8-emb4"
VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN="8192"
VLLM_TP_SIZE="4"
VLLM_MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS="512"
VLLM_LIMIT_MM_PER_PROMPT='{"image":0,"audio":0,"video":0}'
HF_HOME="/dev/shm"

echo "VLLM_MODEL set to: $VLLM_MODEL"
echo "VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN set to: $VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN"
echo "VLLM_TP_SIZE set to: $VLLM_TP_SIZE"
echo "VLLM_MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS set to: $VLLM_MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS"
echo "VLLM_LIMIT_MM_PER_PROMPT set to: $VLLM_LIMIT_MM_PER_PROMPT"
echo "HF_HOME set to: $HF_HOME"

# Fetch the Hugging Face token from Secret Manager at boot.
# The token is NEVER written into instance metadata or this script — it is read at
# runtime with the VM's own service-account credentials from the metadata server.
# Tracing stays off from here on: every line below touches the token.
set +x
echo "Fetching 'hf-token' from Secret Manager (retrying for up to 30 minutes)..."
METADATA_TOKEN_URL="http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token"
SECRET_URL="https://secretmanager.googleapis.com/v1/projects/aisprint-491218/secrets/hf-token/versions/latest:access"

HF_TOKEN=""
set +e
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  ACCESS_TOKEN=$(curl -s -H "Metadata-Flavor: Google" "$METADATA_TOKEN_URL" |
    python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["access_token"])' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$ACCESS_TOKEN" ]; then
    HF_TOKEN=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" "$SECRET_URL" |
      python3 -c 'import base64,json,sys; print(base64.b64decode(json.load(sys.stdin)["payload"]["data"]).decode())' 2>/dev/null)
  fi
  if [ -n "$HF_TOKEN" ]; then
    echo "Secret retrieved successfully on attempt $i (value masked)."
    break
  fi
  echo "Attempt $i/90: could not read the secret yet. Retrying in 20 seconds..."
  echo "  (if this never succeeds, grant the VM service account roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on 'hf-token')"
  sleep 20
done
set -e

if [ -z "$HF_TOKEN" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Could not read 'hf-token' from Secret Manager after 30 minutes."
  echo "Grant the VM's service account roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on the secret, then reset the VM."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Attempting to start vLLM container..."
# Stop and remove any existing container with the same name to ensure a clean start
sudo docker stop vllm-gemma4 > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
sudo docker rm vllm-gemma4 > /dev/null 2>&1 || true

# Log the full docker run command before executing it. HF_TOKEN is deliberately shown
# as a literal placeholder here — do not interpolate it into a logged string.
echo 'Executing command: sudo docker run --name vllm-gemma4 --privileged --net=host -d \
  -v /dev/shm:/dev/shm --shm-size 10gb \
  -e HF_HOME="$HF_HOME" \
  -e HF_TOKEN=<masked> \
  -e MIN_TOKEN_BUCKET=64 -e GMM_V2_TILE_VMEM_FRACTION=0.85 \
  vllm-tpu-w8a8emb4:patched vllm serve "$VLLM_MODEL" \
  --max-model-len "$VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN" \
  --tensor-parallel-size "$VLLM_TP_SIZE" \
  --disable_chunked_mm_input \
  --max_num_batched_tokens "$VLLM_MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS" \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt "$VLLM_LIMIT_MM_PER_PROMPT" \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tool-call-parser gemma4 \
  --reasoning-parser gemma4'

sudo docker run --name vllm-gemma4 --privileged --net=host -d \
  -v /dev/shm:/dev/shm --shm-size 10gb \
  -e HF_HOME="$HF_HOME" \
  -e HF_TOKEN="$HF_TOKEN" \
  -e MIN_TOKEN_BUCKET=64 -e GMM_V2_TILE_VMEM_FRACTION=0.85 \
  vllm-tpu-w8a8emb4:patched vllm serve "$VLLM_MODEL" \
  --max-model-len "$VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN" \
  --tensor-parallel-size "$VLLM_TP_SIZE" \
  --disable_chunked_mm_input \
  --max_num_batched_tokens "$VLLM_MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS" \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt "$VLLM_LIMIT_MM_PER_PROMPT" \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tool-call-parser gemma4 \
  --reasoning-parser gemma4

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Docker run command failed. Check parameters and image."
  sudo docker logs vllm-gemma4 || echo "Could not fetch logs for failed container."
  exit 1
fi

# The token is no longer needed in this shell; drop it and resume tracing.
unset HF_TOKEN ACCESS_TOKEN
set -x

echo "Docker container started. Waiting for 'Application startup complete.' in logs (up to 60 minutes: a 12 GB checkpoint pull, then about 7 minutes of compile)..."
HEALTHY=0
for i in $(seq 1 360); do
  if sudo docker logs vllm-gemma4 2>&1 | grep -q "Application startup complete."; then
    echo "vLLM 'Application startup complete.' message found in logs."
    HEALTHY=1
    break
  fi
  echo "vLLM not yet fully started (attempt $i/360). Retrying in 10 seconds..."
  sleep 10
done

if [ "$HEALTHY" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: vLLM did not report 'Application startup complete.' within the timeout."
  echo "Attempting to retrieve Docker logs for 'vllm-gemma4':"
  sudo docker logs vllm-gemma4 || echo "Could not retrieve Docker logs."
  exit 1
fi

echo "vLLM application startup complete. The server should now be ready."
